title: 5 Taylor Hill Way, Balbriggan, Co. Dublin, K32E704
seoTitle: 5 Taylor Hill Way, Balbriggan, Co. Dublin, K32E704
description:
Halligan O`Connor (Balbriggan) proudly present 5 Taylor Hill Way to the Balbriggan property market. This attractive 3 bedroom family home combines contemporary design, generous living accommodation and excellent energy efficiency. Extending to approximately 102 sq m and boasting an impressive A3 BER, this beautifully presented property offers a superb balance of style, practicality and comfort, making it an ideal choice for families, first-time buyers or those seeking a modern home with plenty of space.

 Externally, the property is well presented and is complimented by an extra-long front garden and driveway, providing ample space for a large vehicle, while the welcoming entrance sets the tone for the accommodation within.

The interior of 5 Taylor Hill Way is bright, spacious and thoughtfully designed for comfortable modern living. The ground floor features a welcoming hallway, a generous living room filled with natural light, and a contemporary open-plan kitchen and dining area with ample storage, modern appliances and a breakfast space overlooking the rear garden. Laminate flooring runs throughout the ground floor, while the upstairs accommodation is finished with carpets for added warmth and comfort. There are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en-suite, floor-to-ceiling wardrobes and blackout curtains, while two further bedrooms benefit from blackout blinds. High-quality blinds are fitted throughout the property, and the home also benefits from a floored attic with Stira access, providing excellent additional storage. An A3 BER, solar panels, central ventilation system and gas-fired central heating further enhance the comfort, efficiency and practicality of this impressive family home.

To the front, the property benefits from an unusually long and well-maintained garden and driveway, providing generous off-street parking with ample room for a large vehicle.

The rear garden offers considerable potential for a new owner to create a truly special outdoor space. While currently in need of upgrading, its generous proportions provide an excellent blank canvas for landscaping, children`s play areas, outdoor dining or the creation of a peaceful garden retreat.



Balbriggan benefits from excellent public transport connections, with bus and rail services within walking distance, providing convenient commuting options to Dublin city. The nearby motorway network also allows straightforward access to Dublin Airport, the city centre and destinations throughout the wider region.

The coastal town continues to benefit from significant regeneration and investment through the `Our Balbriggan` project, with an estimated €57 million being invested in improvements to the town centre, harbour and surrounding public spaces.

Balbriggan also boasts a distinctive cultural and recreational offering, including the nearby Irish Institute of Music & Song, while beautiful coastal surroundings and an excellent selection of local primary and secondary schools add to the area`s appeal. Ardgillan Castle & Demesne is just a short drive away, providing extensive parkland, walking routes and picturesque surroundings overlooking the Irish Sea.

Taylor Hill Way provides an appealing residential setting for those seeking a modern home with the space and layout required for contemporary family life. The property`s generous accommodation, excellent energy rating and outdoor space make it particularly attractive to buyers looking for a comfortable long-term home. 

Combining contemporary interiors, an A3 BER, approximately 102 sqm of accommodation and excellent potential both inside and out, 5 Taylor Hill Way is a superb 3 bedroom family home for sale in Balbriggan.

Contact Halligan O`Connor, Balbriggan Estate Agents, to arrange a private viewing.
